overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Blue Chip Growth ETF (TCHP) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TCHP is an actively-managed, non-transparent fund that focus on companies with potential for above-average growth TCHP was launched on Aug 4, 2020 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
